naslov: Luka Doncic returns for Lakers; Austin Reaves, Quentin Grimes out vs. Hawks
tekst:
ATLANTA -- The Los Angeles Lakers got Luka Doncic back in the lineup Monday against the Atlanta Hawks but were not at full strength with Austin Reaves (illness) and Quentin Grimes (sprained finger on right hand) both out. 
Despite being short-handed, the Lakers beat the Hawks 124-114 to improve to 10-2. They are on a six-game winning streak. 
Reaves scored a season-high 43 points in Sunday's 121-116 win over the Detroit Pistons while Doncic was sidelined because of lower back tightness.
Doncic finished with 32 points Monday after scoring 40-plus in four straight games. He leads the league with a 40.1 points-per-game average. 
Lakers coach JJ Redick said that with Reaves and Grimes sidelined, he planned to give early rotation minutes to rookie Cameron Carr, L.A.'s first-round pick.
